body:
I looked into making videos a bit this is what I found.

1. Write your story/script should be about 90 seconds ish generally
- make it clear who you are talking to 
- capture attention within 7 seconds 
- capture a problem that people have 
- state the solution that you have 
- show the benefits 
- call to action 
- end on a positive 
2. Record the voice over. I can give it a shot I do have nice microphones 
3. Use voice over to set the timing of slides possible animation software to use (Toonly, Powtoon, doodly,) 
4. Populate the slides with images and transitions 
5. Polish the voice over and audio I can add the sound effects and make everything sound nice at the end of the day. We should get a professional voice over artist I think (fiver or voice bunny)
6. Add in background music and fine tune timing
